description: One of three Gnat/Ajeet airframes pole-mounted in vic formation on the front lawn of Air HQ facing Rafi Marg; installed mid-1990s, removed to IAF Museum Palam in 2008 during Metro construction and re-erected by 2014 (WBI, updated 2022). Folland-built Gnat c/n GT-021 per Bharat Rakshak. Serial identity note: a second Gnat marked IE-1205 exists in a Nagpur park; WBI considers the Delhi aircraft the genuine one but this is unresolved. Visible from the public road; guards may object to photography. Coordinates from WBI map fix on the display.
aliases: FollandGnat; Gnat Mk1; GT-021; GT021; IE-1205

description: HAL Ajeet (Gnat Mk II) pole-mounted in the Vayu Bhavan vic formation, believed one of the last Ajeets retired by No.2 Sqn in the late 1980s (WBI). Bharat Rakshak: preserved Vayu Bhavan Delhi. Only aircraft of the three confirmed as an Ajeet.
aliases: Gnat Mk2; Gnat II; HAL Gnat Ajeet; E-1975

description: Third Gnat of the Vayu Bhavan formation. Painted serial reads "IE-246", which is not a valid IAF serial; WBI suggests true identity is IE-1246 or E-246 (Bharat Rakshak files it as E-246 with a query). tail_number left blank; painted marking recorded in aliases.
